MINUTES  FOR  THE  REGULAR  MEETING  OF THE
  HOUSING  AUTHORITY  OF THE  CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE

  TUESDAY,  NOVEMBER  26, 2024

CALL  TO ORDER  The meeting  of the South  Gate Housing  Authority  was called  to order by
  Chairperson  Gil Hurtado  at 6:48 p.m.

ROLL  CALL  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk

PRESENT  Chairperson  Gil Hurtado,  Vice  Chairperson  Maria  Davila,  Authority
  Member  Joshua Barron,  Authority  Member  Maria  del Pilar Avalos,  and
  Authority  Member  Al Rios;  City Treasurer  Jose De La Paz, Executive
  Director  Rob Houston,  Authority  Counsel  Raul F. Salinas

I
SGHA  ADMINISTRATIVE

PLAN  UPDATES  The City  of South  Gate Housing  Authority  unanimously  adopted
  Resolution  No. 2024-01-HA  entitled  Resolution  of the South  Gate
  Housing  Authority,  South Gate, California,  adopting  the South  Gate
  Housing  Authority  Administrative  Plan updates  by motion  of Authority
  Member  Avalos  and seconded  by Authority  Member  Rios.

  ROLL  CALL:  Authority  Member  Avalos,  yes; Authority  Member
  Barron,  yes; Authority  Member  Rios, yes; Vice  Chairperson  Davila,  yes;
  Chairperson  Hurtado,  yes.

  Executive  Director  Houston  stated Caror Averell,  Housing  Division
  Manager  will  provide  the presentation.

  Ms. Averell  provided  the presentation.

  Chairperson  Hurtado  asked if anyone  in the audience  wished  to speak on
  this item or any emails  received.  Seeing  no one step forward  nor any
  emails  received;  Chairperson  Hurtado  closed  the audience  portion.

2

  Meeting  minutes  of March  26, 2024, by motion  of Authority  Member  Rios
  and seconded  by Chairperson  Hurtado.

  ROLL  CALL:  Authority  Member  Avalos,  yes; Authority  Member
  Barron,  yes; Authority  Member  Rios, yes; Vice  Chairperson  Davila,  yes;
  Chairperson  Hurtado,  yes.

  Chairperson  Hurtado  asked if anyone  in the audience  wished  to speak on
  this item or any emails  received.  Seeing  no one step forward  nor any
  emails  received;  Chairperson  Hurtado  closed  the audience  portion.
